camel_example: aliyun rds ModifyRCInstance --region cn-hangzhou --RebootTime '2025-04-03T12:05Z' --BusinessInfo 'example-string' --InstanceId 'rm-uf62br2491p5l0000' --AutoUseCoupon true --PromotionCode 723298850000 --DryRun true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AutoPay true --InstanceType 'mysql.i8.large.2cm' --Direction Up --RebootWhenFinished true
description_zh: 调用ModifyRCInstance接口，升级或者降低一台RDS Custom实例的实例规格
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-rc-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id rm-uf62br2491p5l0000 --instance-type mysql.i8.large.2cm --direction Up --auto-pay true --dry-run true --reboot-when-finished true --reboot-time 2025-04-03T12:05Z --auto-use-coupon true --promotion-code 723298850000 --business-info example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRCInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The new instance type. For more information about the instance types that are supported by RDS Custom instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2844823.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要变配的目标实例规格。RDS Custom实例支持的资源规格，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2844823.html
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the change that you want to perform on the instance. Valid values:

This parameter is optional. The system can automatically determine whether the instance change is an upgrade or a downgrade. If you want to specify this parameter, take note of the following items:

Upgrade (default): upgrades the instance type. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
Down: downgrades the instance type. If the new instance type specified by InstanceType has lower specifications than the current instance type, set Direction to Down
parameters.help_zh:
实例变配类型，取值范围：
该参数可无需上传，系统可自动判断升配还是降配；如要上传，请按照下面的逻辑规则操作。
Up（默认）：升配实例规格。请确保您的账户支付方式余额充足。
Down：降配实例规格。当InstanceType设置的实例规格低于当前实例规格时，设置Direction=down
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the automatic payment feature. Valid values:

true (default): enables the feature. You must make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
false: disables the feature. An unpaid order is generated.

If your account balance is insufficient, you can set AutoPay to false. In this case, an unpaid order is generated. You can complete the payment in the Expenses and Costs console
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。取值范围：
true（默认）：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足。
false：只生成订单不扣费。
如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将参数AutoPay设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录RDS管理控制台自行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, service limits, and resource inventory.
false: performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次创建实例的操作执行预检查，取值范围：
true：执行预检查操作，不创建实例。检查项目包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
Whether to restart the instance immediately after the upgrade/downgrade operation ends. Valid values:
true (default): Yes.
false: No.
If the instance is in the paused status, it remains in that status even if you set `RebootWhenFinished=true`, and the restart operation will not be executed
parameters.help_zh:
实例变配结束后是否立即重启。取值范围：

true（默认）：是。
false：否。

若实例处于已暂停状态，即使您设置了`RebootWhenFinished=true`，也会保持原状态不变，并不会执行重启操作
parameters.name: reboot_when_finished

parameters.help_en:
The restart time of the instance.

If RebootWhenFinished is set to false, you must specify a restart time within 48 hours.
The time must follow the ISO 8601 standard in UTC+0. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`
parameters.help_zh:
实例的重启时间。

RebootWhenFinished设置为false且实例状态为Running时，必须设置48小时以内的重启时间。
按照ISO 8601标准表示，使用UTC+0时间。格式为：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`
parameters.name: reboot_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically use a coupon. Valid values:
true (default): Yes.
false: No.

If you use a coupon and later decrease the quota, the amount offset by the coupon will not be refunded
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
true（默认）：是。
false：否。

使用优惠券后，若需要进行降配操作，由代金券抵扣的金额将不会进行退款
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon
